bottomLine: One hard deadline today: Heartspring's spring-order deposit requires confirmation by end of day or the order slips a week. BDA fund figures are settled and ready to report to the board. Tomorrow's 9:00 AM greenhouse call is missing the supplier numbers it depends on.
keyPoints: Maya Fields requires deposit confirmation by EOD; the spring order proceeds only on confirmation.
Zachary's report confirms $16,670 ABO carryover from FY 25-26; ready for board summary.
Supplier Desk has not returned the revised quote — second day outstanding.
Ari's dinner question is on its second day without a response.
Tomorrow: greenhouse planning call 9:00 AM, Biodynamics review 3:30 PM.

items.title: Spring order deposit confirmation
items.background: Maya Fields flagged the deposit Monday. A revised supplier quote was requested Tuesday and remains outstanding.
items.development: Maya escalated today: confirmation is required before end of day for the order to proceed.
items.assessment: The base quote stands; a one-week slip in planting is the cost of missing today's deadline. The outstanding quote revision is minor relative to the schedule risk.
items.memory: Deposit confirmation due 7/25 EOD; awaiting Ben's reply. Revised supplier quote still outstanding (day 2). Watch for Maya's shipping confirmation.

items.title: ABO fund carryover — figures settled
items.background: Requested last FY's ABO figures from Zachary Krebs two weeks ago for board allocation planning.
items.development: Report received: $20,000 allocated, $2,730 spent, $600 admin fee — $16,670 carried over.
items.assessment: Figures are complete and uncontested. Item closes once summarized to the board; no response from Zachary required.
items.memory: ABO carryover confirmed at $16,670. Pending: Ben's summary to board, then mark resolved.

items.title: Dinner scheduling — Ari

items.action: Reply with a choice of night.
items.memory: Ari awaiting dinner answer (asked 7/24, again 7/25). Calendar favors Thursday.
